name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 35 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-08-11, at wavelengths from 1.14 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
